title: DRAFT CW-AIP v2 ArtifactEnvelope payload (not enforced)
description: Draft only. No validator applies this schema and a v2 ArtifactEnvelope envelope is still rejected; keep emitting ArtifactEnvelope as v1 until this draft is promoted. Fields may change without notice.

artifact_kind.description: What the immutable artifact is, e.g. audit-report, ci-snapshot, evidence-pack

artifact_hash.description: Content hash of the artifact bytes, e.g. sha256:<hex>

locator.description: URI, path or commit-pinned pointer to the artifact
